U.S. Senate Committee on Appropriations 
Subcommittee on the Legislative Branch 
Outside Witness Testimony Instructions 
Fiscal Year 2027 Appropriations 
The Senate Subcommittee on the Legislative Branch has not scheduled any outside 
witness hearings on appropriations for fiscal year 2027.  However, as in past years, 
written testimony will be accepted in accordance with the guidelines below. 
GUIDELINES 
Format: 
x Testimony (including any supporting material) should be a maximum of four (4)
pages, on 8 ½” x 11” paper, single sided, single spaced, and have a 1” margin.
x Do not include a cover page.
x At the top of the first page, list the name of the person or organization submitting
testimony; that it is prepared for the Subcommittee on the Legislative Branch; and
which Office and/or Agency the testimony is addressing.
Delivery: 
x Delivery is by electronic submission only, as described below.  Other forms of 
delivery, including fax and delivery through the mail, will not be accepted.
x Please e-mail testimony to legislativebranch@appro.senate.gov with the subject 
line “FY27 LegisBranch OWT”.
x To facilitate printing, we can only accept testimony in Microsoft Word or Word 
Perfect formats.  DO NOT SEND PDF FILES.
x In the email, please include contact information (name, email, physical address 
and telephone).
Deadline: 
xAll material must be received no later than close of business, Friday, May 15, 
2026.  This deadline will be strictly enforced.
Thank you. 
Subcommittee on the Legislative Branch 
Committee on Appropriations 
United States Senate 
Washington, DC 20510
